subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should experimental `claws remove` retain the proposed model of globally retained plugins, workspace-scoped final-reference skill cleanup, no permanent removal tombstone, and explicitly consented `--force-referenced` cleanup?
rationale: This chooses durable operator-facing lifecycle semantics and recovery/audit behavior; source review can assess implementation safety but cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Approve the scoped lifecycle policy
options.body: Keep plugins retained by default, allow only consent-bound explicit referenced cleanup, and rely on partial provenance for status/retry rather than a permanent tombstone.

options.title: Require a tombstone or narrower cleanup
options.body: Pause merge until the owner defines durable post-removal audit state or removes the force-selected artifact path from this experimental slice.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Keep plugins retained by default, allow only consent-bound explicit referenced cleanup, and rely on partial provenance for status/retry rather than a permanent tombstone.
